title: GrowthPattern
description: A growth pattern template (blueprint: Growth Pattern Library — the 'how children grow' layer between Capability Graph and arcs). MVP patterns: discovery / build / help / challenge / story_creation. An arc = pattern template × topic × child interests (blueprint Q18: template library + AI personalization). Patterns are DATA, not code.

chapter_skeleton.description: Ordered chapter roles with difficulty gradient; instantiated into arc chapters (mission-arc.schema.json).

role.description: hook: narrative entry; practice: guided task; creation: child produces something (transfer test); reflection: retelling.

task_pattern.description: Offline activity template (zh), may contain {theme}/{topic} placeholders.

key_signals.description: Observables that confirm the pattern worked for this child (feeds growth_hypothesis.key_signal).
